blocks.text: Earlier this year, several schools in Novosibirsk, a city of 1.6 million in southern Siberia, received a textbook on patriotism from the authorities. According to students, with whom DW spoke to on condition of anonymity, in the book the authors urge children to prepare themselves to die for their country. Furthermore, they equate homosexuality with pedophilia and Disney cartoons with pornography, and give instructions on how women should use their “charms.” Europeans are described as “thieves, murderers and liars.” The textbook, which provides “materials for spiritual, moral, and patriotic upbringing” is supposed to be used as part of “patriotism lessons” that […]...
